description: Rules for the Product Knowledge Skill. Governs how application pages, workflows, navigation and business rules are discovered from the live Playwright browser and persisted to the Product Knowledge Base (PKB). The skill reads this at runtime instead of hardcoding rules.
pipelinePosition: First agent in the documentation pipeline. Output is consumed by the QE Planner as primary business context before any JIRA story analysis.

allowed: Existing Product Knowledge Base at the resolved per-app {pkbDir}
User navigation performed during this execution
App registry entry pipeline-config.json → apps[appKey] (for pkbDir/envConfig resolution)

outputs.baseDirResolution: {pkbDir} = pipeline-config.json → apps[appKey].pkbDir (e.g. qe-pipeline/knowledge/product-TCOE). Isolated per app, mirroring suiteDir/envConfig. If an app entry has no pkbDir, default to qe-pipeline/knowledge/product-{appKey} and write it back into the entry.
outputs.forbidden: Never create documentation outside the resolved {pkbDir} for the app being documented. Never write into another app's PKB or the bare qe-pipeline/knowledge/product/. No JIRA writes, no test cases, no automation code.

mcp.ifUnavailable: HALT and report the dependency. Never fabricate DOM, URLs, navigation, or screenshots.

screenFile.convention: kebab-case derived from route or page name

screen: Page Details (Page Name, Module, URL, Title)

evidence.principle: Evidence-first. Document only what is directly observable in the live browser.
rules: No component documented without it being present in the DOM snapshot or screenshot
No URL recorded without confirming it via the browser address
No navigation path recorded without observing the transition
Do not infer backend logic, API contracts, DB tables, or status codes
Follow .kiro/steering/anti-hallucination.md for all placeholder and evidence rules

guidance.High: Directly observed in the live browser during this session
guidance.Medium: Observed but partially inferred (e.g. next step implied by text)
guidance.Low: Downstream or dependent behaviour not yet directly observed
guidance.Unknown: Cannot be verified — must be labelled Unknown, never guessed

confidence.rule: Every screen and workflow document must end with a Confidence section. Inferred content must be tagged (e.g. 'inferred from URL pattern').

rules: Always read the existing document before writing
Record only newly discovered navigation paths
Mark inferred routes explicitly (e.g. 'Unknown (inferred from URL pattern)')
Update Last Updated stamp in navigation-map.md when routes change

stopConditions.action: Mark as Unknown — do not invent

summaryFormat.rule: Do not print complete documentation in chat unless the user requests it.
